description: Committed output-result inventory. Every bundled executor in the default registry either writes a universal result manifest (non-exempt) or appears here with a specific M2-approved reason; optional external routes remain explicitly listed without being treated as bundled discovery. The registry conformance gate uses this list to allow non-conforming executors while making the gap visible.

blender.render.note: Runs Blender locally or through an external render host and does not yet write the universal result manifest.

comfy_wrap.run.note: Runs ComfyUI workflows through external VibeComfy/ComfyUI tooling requiring GPU.

discord_local.command.note: Bundled Discord-local source pack exposes an optional browser route; execution still requires a separately installed runner and headed Chrome, so the route remains an external escape hatch.

editorial.human_review.note: Interactive HTTP review server for human-gate approval with no stable output artifact.

editorial.inspect_cut.note: Read-only inspection tool for cut run directories with no produced artifact.

fal.fal_foley.note: fal.ai hunyuan-video-foley model requiring FAL_KEY API token and external GPU infrastructure.

hivemind.contribute.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.get_item.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.ingest_article.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.ingest_workflow.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.ingest_youtube.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.refresh_media.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

hivemind.search.note: Optional Hivemind executor declared by config/astrid-beta-capabilities.json; no bundled executor manifest is installed in this checkout.

moirae.moirae.note: External Moirae screenplay-to-video tool requiring paid API access and GPU infrastructure.

rendering.render.note: Renders brief timeline to video through Remotion with GPU-accelerated rendering.

runpod.exec.note: Executes scripts on provisioned RunPod GPU pods requiring paid RunPod account.

runpod.provision.note: Provisions RunPod GPU pods requiring paid RunPod account.

runpod.pull.note: Pulls remote artifacts from RunPod pods via SSH requiring paid RunPod account.

runpod.session.note: Composite provision-exec-download-teardown RunPod session requiring paid account.

runpod.teardown.note: Terminates RunPod pods requiring paid RunPod account.

seedance_local.reference_video.note: Bundled Seedance source pack invokes the optional paid Fal.ai route and requires FAL_KEY; the route remains an explicit external escape hatch.

stream_content.clip_candidates.note: Writes ranked clip-candidate JSON but does not yet emit a universal result manifest.

stream_content.distill.note: Writes segment_map.json, segments/segments.json, candidates.json, and review.html, but does not yet emit the universal result manifest; explicit universal-manifest debt, consistent with the existing stream_content no-artifact entries.

stream_content.segment_map.note: Writes segment-map JSON but does not yet emit a universal result manifest.

training.dataset_build.note: Writes dataset-domain final.manifest.json, an adapter manifest, and quality_report.json; local-source execution is supported, but the universal result manifest is not yet emitted.

training.search_loras.note: Searches Hugging Face Hub for LoRA adapters requiring HF_TOKEN/HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN.

training.training_run.note: Runs remote RunPod GPU training/provisioning and artifact transfer; emits domain run state, normalized trainer manifest, review index, and LoRA registration, but not the universal result manifest.

understanding.understand.note: Dispatch router delegating to paid audio/visual/video understanding executors (OpenAI, etc.).

vibecomfy.edit.note: Edits VibeComfy workflows through external VibeComfy CLI; outputs stay with the external tool.

vibecomfy.import.note: Imports workflows through the external VibeComfy porting service; the canonical bundle outputs are settled without a universal result manifest.

vibecomfy.inspect.note: Inspects VibeComfy workflows through external VibeComfy CLI with no Astrid result receipt.

vibecomfy.validate.note: Validates VibeComfy workflows through external VibeComfy CLI.

video_editing.event_talks.note: Writes plan.json; the renderer remains a stub, and no universal result manifest is emitted.

video_editing.sync_draft_voiceover.note: Returns caller-bound report and receipt mappings without stable worker-owned output paths; no universal result manifest can be harvested.

video_editing.thumbnail_maker.note: Writes plan.json only; thumbnail generation remains a stub, and no universal result manifest is emitted.

wan2gp.validate_settings.note: Compiles and validates Wan2GP settings without producing a media artifact.

youtube.upload.note: Uploads finished video to YouTube via Zapier integration requiring paid API access.
